snippet.title: Baby Pac-Man Arcade 1.7 Million Points (PinMAME + VPX)
snippet.description:
My record in the real machine is over 4 million. VPX new version of this machine imitates the real thing amazingly well. Here's some advanced playing tips for this great, underrated classic strategy/arcade game.

You can get this game for Visual Pinball X from here:
http://www.vpforums.org/index.php?app=downloads&showfile=13039

Visual Pinball X + PinMAME all-in one installer is here:
http://www.vpforums.org/index.php?app=downloads&showfile=11573

You also need a ROM file for VpinMAME for Baby Pac-Man (babypac.zip).
https://www.vpforums.org/index.php?app=downloads&showfile=406

Arcade history has largely forgotten this very underrated game, which requires a lot of strategy to advance deeper in the mazes. Very enjoyable and challenging masterpiece.
